This '''[[rebel technician]]''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a member of the [[Massassi Group]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. He was stationed at [[Great Temple|Base One]] on [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This character was portrayed by [[Robin Pearce]], where he was credited as a Rebel Technician #2.<ref name="Rogue One" />
